```yaml
name: Claude Code Integration

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  claude-code:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Run Claude Code action
        id: claude-code
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          trigger_phrase: '@claude'
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Check if Claude response contains "hello"
        if: steps.claude-code.outputs.conclusion == 'success' && contains(steps.claude-code.outputs.execution_file, 'hello')
        run: echo "Claude responded with 'hello'"

  pid-generator:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: claude-code
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build solution
        run: dotnet build --configuration Release

      - name: Run PID generator tests
        run: dotnet test PKMDS-Blazor.Tests --filter Category=PIDGenerator

  bug-report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: claude-code
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build solution
        run: dotnet build --configuration Release

      - name: Run bug report tests
        run: dotnet test PKMDS-Blazor.Tests --filter Category=BugReport
```
